'''Haley''' (Japanese: '''ハツネ''' ''Hatsune'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP021|Ya See We Want An Evolution!]]''.

She is the leader of the [[B-Button League]] and the older sister of [[Oralie]]. As the leader of the League, she aims to make her {{p|Feebas}} beautiful without evolving it.

|desc=Haley's {{p|Feebas}} appeared in ''[[DP021|Ya See We Want An Evolution!]]'', where it was part of the [[B-Button League]], a group of {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s that do not [[Evolution|evolve]] their Pokémon. After the group met Haley and [[Oralie]], Magikarp and Feebas jumped out the water, showing off their beauty.

Later, with their new [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]], {{TRT}} grabbed Feebas and Magikarp so they can evolve them into a {{p|Milotic}} and {{p|Gyarados}}, respectively. Pikachu tried to use {{m|Thunderbolt}} to break them out, but was captured too. The trio attempted to evolve the Pokémon but the machine did not work, after which Pikachu used {{m|Iron Tail}} to break them out and destroy the mecha. Along with Magikarp, Feebas battled Team Rocket, using Ice Beam alongside Magikarp's {{m|Tackle}}, which sent Team Rocket blasting off.

Feebas's only known move is {{m|Ice Beam}}.}}
